description: Returns the current table of a league with a season projection from tens of thousands of seasons simulated with the free Dixon-Coles model offered by Docteur Bet: each team's chances of winning the title, finishing in Champions League and European places, being relegated, and its projected final points. Not available for cups or for leagues whose format the simulator does not handle (see list_competitions).

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

name: get_season_projection
title: Season projection
